original.target_description: Verified matching Staniland and Byrne (2013) full-text accepted manuscript. Study examines adolescent boys, three conditions, three time points, and knowledge (AKQ), attitudes (ACL), and behavioural intentions (SAQ). Supplied locator p. 7 and the description do not specify a unique outcome, comparison, time contrast, or test. The manuscript has pagination different from the published article. Multiple main effects, interactions, and follow-up tests are reported; no single test selected.

replication.target_description: Published Ranson and Byrne (2014) article; female school students assigned to intervention, no-intervention peer and no-intervention non-peer conditions. PDF page 9 contains both knowledge and attitude outcomes, with multiple main effects, interactions, subgroup/time tests and comparisons. The supplied description does not specify which outcome or test is assigned to this audit_id.

notes:
Blind extraction. No effect assignment inferred from input order. Original full text was acquired from the University of Wollongong institutional repository via Figshare and its title verified. Original is available; unresolved issue is test identification, not paper availability. Generic recruited sample was not treated as analytic n. Replication acquisition failure recorded in texts/aa4d2598f34ea5adf20855eb.miss. Authors' narrative replication verdict not extracted from abstract-only access.
Source follow-up: Fresh blind replication-only validation. Published article version, DOI/title/authors match supplied reference. PDF p. 9 visually inspected. Audit IDs 1980 and 1981 have the same replication page locator and the same neutral description covering knowledge, attitudes and behavioural intentions. Their outcome/test assignments cannot be distinguished without inferring from input order or consulting prohibited material. Knowledge section prints condition, time and interaction F tests plus several follow-ups; attitude section prints condition, time and interaction F tests plus pairwise comparisons. No arbitrary test selected. Page 5 gives recruitment/condition totals and page 8 Table 1 gives generic condition Ns, which do not establish a unique target-test analytic N. Canonical text renders less-than signs as backslashes and eta-squared as gp2; rendered PDF confirms conventional mathematical symbols. No quote normalization or metric conversion performed. Original is an unassigned placeholder, not a finding that its paper is unavailable.
